answer: To deter Sybil attacks, an agent economy can enforce proof of space-time, requiring nodes to commit verifiable cryptographic tables to storage. An adversary incurs the verifiable cost of scarce physical drive capacity per identity to answer ongoing audit queries. This framework establishes a secure haven that stems the tide of spoofed agents, allowing peers to terrace routing priority by stored volume. However, wealthy entities can exploit economies of scale in commercial storage hardware.
